leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a recursive function to generate valid parentheses combinations
Construct a backtracking algorithm that tracks open and close parentheses counts
Initialize and manipulate arrays to store valid parentheses sequences
Apply constraints to ensure parentheses combinations remain balanced
Control recursion depth by tracking the number of parentheses used
Integrate base cases to terminate recursion when parentheses limits are reached
Render the final array of valid parentheses combinations as output
